Decision Study (D-Study) Reliability Projections & Optimal Design Solver

Source: R/d_study.R
d_study.Rd

Projects Generalizability (\(E\rho^2\)) and Dependability (\(\Phi\)) coefficients across candidate facet counts (e.g., grids of n_prompts x n_models), computes single-facet reliability asymptotes, and identifies minimum-cost designs achieving a target reliability threshold.

Usage

d_study(
  g_study,
  grid = NULL,
  target = 0.85,
  metric = c("g", "phi"),
  n_replicates = 1L,
  costs = NULL
)

Arguments

g_study

An object of class "llm_g_study" returned by g_study().

grid

Optional named list of positive integer vectors giving candidate counts for each facet in g_study$facets (e.g. list(prompt = 1:8, model = 1:4)). Missing facets default to sensible candidate sequences.

target

Target reliability threshold in (0, 1). Default 0.85.

metric

Reliability coefficient used for target recommendations: "g" (relative \(E\rho^2\), default) or "phi" (absolute \(\Phi\)).

n_replicates

Positive integer replicate count per cell in the D-study projection. Defaults to 1L.

costs

Optional named numeric vector of relative cost weights per unit increase in each facet (e.g. c(prompt = 1, model = 2)). If NULL, total LLM calls (prod(n_facets) * n_replicates) is minimized.

Value

An S3 object of class "llm_d_study" with elements:

  • grid: tibble of all evaluated D-study designs with facet counts, total_calls, cost, g_coef, phi_coef, sem_relative, sem_absolute, and meets_target.

  • recommendations: tibble of Pareto-minimal / lowest-cost designs satisfying metric >= target (empty tibble if unattainable in grid).

  • asymptotes: tibble giving theoretical ceiling \(E\rho^2\) and \(\Phi\) when each facet tends to infinity while other facets stay at 1 or at their observed G-study counts.

  • target, metric, facets, n_replicates, g_study.

Examples

data(ema_coded)
g <- g_study(ema_coded, score_col = "llm_score", facets = c("prompt", "model"))
d <- d_study(g, grid = list(prompt = 1:8, model = 1:4), target = 0.85)
d
#> 
#> ── Decision Study (D-Study) Projections 
#> Evaluated 32 designs | Target: G (Erho^2) >= 0.85
#> Lowest-cost recommended design: prompt=2, model=1 (2 calls/unit -> G = 0.902,
#> Phi = 0.889)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 10
#>   prompt model n_replicates total_calls  cost g_coef phi_coef sem_relative
#>    <int> <int>        <int>       <dbl> <dbl>  <dbl>    <dbl>        <dbl>
#> 1      2     1            1           2     2  0.902    0.889        0.436
#> 2      1     2            1           2     2  0.890    0.874        0.463
#> # ℹ 2 more variables: sem_absolute <dbl>, meets_target <lgl>
